title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series

messages.subject: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is good to hear from you again. For this work, we can offer a price of €36.00 per unit. We have our CNC machines ready and look forward to putting this job onto the shop floor for you. 

Let me know if this works for you so we can get started soon.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body: Please consider these complete packages for the stated requirement. A valid competing offer is EUR 33 per unit (offer:70240-1); please improve your complete package. PPI-C2431 fell from 131.9 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05) to 129.1 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08), a change of -2.12%. Your latest scorecard records on-time delivery of 80.8% (sc:70210@2026Q3).

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Hallo, I checked your numbers and you make fair points about the material index and our delivery last quarter. I can drop the price to 31.00 EUR for 35 days lead time to beat that other offer, but we must keep payment at 30 days. We need the cash flowing to keep the shop running smoothly for you.

We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the index change and rival quote and delivery record data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. We have free capacity for your parts. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. 

Our Angebot stands at a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. Our Lieferzeit is 35 days. With overtime we can deliver in 28 days, at a premium.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: RFQ pump shaft HX (part:320070) – revised complete packages
messages.body:
Hallo Herr Dralveck,

Thank you for your revised offer and for checking our data so carefully.

A valid competing offer is EUR 30.5 per unit (offer:70250-1); please improve your complete package.

You told us at our supplier day that Hollerau is an important reference customer for you. We would like to place the HX shaft with you. The attached packages cover 4200 pc a year over 24 months. One package has a shorter payment term, which addresses your cash flow.

Could you also confirm your earliest lead time for series start in March 2027?

Gruß
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: RFQ pump shaft HX (part:320070) – revised complete packages
messages.body:

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have clarified this internally and can move further on the price. messages.subject: HX pump shaft – updated packages
messages.body:
Hallo Herr Dralveck,

Thank you for moving on price and for confirming the 35-day lead time.

Your previous scorecard records 1997 ppm (sc:70210@2026Q2).

We keep the 14-day payment you value for your cash flow. The attached packages cover 4200 pc a year over 24 months, DAP Hollerau, with no tooling. They give you a steady, fully scheduled load for the capacity you have free. As you said at our supplier day, the HX series would also be a strong reference for you.

Is there a cheaper variant, for example in lot size or call-off rhythm, that would let you move further on price within these terms?

Gruß
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: HX pump shaft – updated packages
messages.body:
Hallo,

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

We offer a price of €28.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

We have already taken that quality record data into account. I have to hold firm at 28.50 EUR for the 14-day payment to keep the shop running. 

If you want to talk bigger lot sizes to save money, send me the exact batch numbers you can take and I'll run the math. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Which volume can you commit to? 

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 1.10 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.82 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.51 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. Our current defect rate for you is about 1200 ppm. We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH
Thread ended: walked_away
